Replaces all 5 cats, all 5 dogs, the horse, and both turtle pet icons that appear at character creation and in the pet adoption window at Marnie's shop with animated versions! 

Using SpaceCore, a portion of "Content\LooseSprites\Cursors.xnb" is replaced with our ([url=http://www.nexusmods.com/users/75703183]PaulDunstan[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6056146]Myself[/url]) edited versions.

Toggle each pet's animation on/off in the config options! Recommended to use GMCM. After downloading click mod options at the bottom of the in-game options menu and then select this mod from the list, each pet will have a check box in there. Uncheck the box to stop animation for that animal making it compatible with animal replacer mods.
[/size][/font][size=2][font=Arial]

[/font][/size]

[img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645779750-777928429.png[/img]

[color=#f1c232][b]2)[/b] [/color]Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

[color=#f1c232][b]3)[/b] [/color]Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].﻿

[b][color=#f1c232]4)[/color][/b] Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].

[color=#f1c232][b]5)[/b] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]6)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Move the extracted folder (which contains the assets folder as well as, content.json, & manifest.json) into your "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this: "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Animated Pet Icons\assets"[/size]
[color=#f1c232]
[b]7)[/b][/color][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size][font=Arial][size=2]
